heroHeadline: Russian Drone Hits Kyiv-Warsaw Train Near Polish Border as Ukraine Strikes Tatarstan Refinery, Mass Barrage Kills 11
heroSubtitle: A Russian drone struck a Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train and a gas station roughly 2km from the Polish border near the Yahodyn crossing on September 13 — Foreign Minister Sybiha called it Russian terror 'knocking directly at the doors of the EU and NATO,' though no injuries were reported. Hours earlier, Ukrainian drones struck the TANECO oil refinery in Nizhnekamsk, Tatarstan, 1,200km from the border. The strikes followed a September 12 mass overnight barrage of 129 drones and 14+ missiles that killed 11 and injured 96 nationwide, hitting Odesa hardest and damaging the Zaporizhstal steel plant; Ukraine's Navy separately claimed the first-ever naval drone-vs-drone battle in the Black Sea, and ISW assessed Ukraine has erased nearly all of Russia's 2026 territorial gains. Russian military losses reached ~1,506,900 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff, an increase of ~1,520 in the latest 24 hours.
